body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose one ally within 4 units. Until your next turn, reduce forced movement against it by 2 units and it ignores difficult terrain.

surges.html: Increase the forced-movement reduction granted by this Action by 1 unit.
Choose one additional ally adjacent to the first; it ignores difficult terrain until your next turn.

rider.title: WATER THREAD
rider.html: After resolving this Action, create a Thread. Consume this Thread when a future Magecraft Action grants Defense or movement resistance to increase that benefit by 1.
